title: Laxmi Grits — remaining bill installments relegated to Clause 6.14
coram: Dilip Gupta, J.; Siddhartha Varma, J.
disposition: Writ disposed; consumer left to avail Clause 6.14 installments
headnote: Where the only relief pressed was permission to deposit the remaining electricity bill in installments, the Allahabad High Court disposed of the writ leaving the consumer to the installment facility under Clause 6.14 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005.
facts: M/s Laxmi Grits Pvt. Ltd. filed Writ-C No. 4200 of 2017 in the Allahabad High Court against the State of Uttar Pradesh and others. At the hearing, counsel for the petitioner pressed only one relief: permission to deposit the remaining amount of an electricity bill in installments. Counsel for the respondents submitted that the petitioner could avail the facility provided under Clause 6.14 of the Electricity Supply Code, 2005. The Division Bench disposed of the petition on that footing.

holding_units.holding: Where the sole relief pressed is permission to deposit the remaining amount of an electricity bill in installments, the writ is disposed of leaving the consumer to avail the remedy under Clause 6.14 of the Electricity Supply Code, 2005.

not_decided.point: Entitlement to, and terms of, any installment facility under Clause 6.14
not_decided.note: The Court did not examine the remaining bill on merits or fix an installment schedule.
